01 / THE PERSON

A thoughtful eye.
A curious mind.

I’m Maria Niña Grace L. Pascua, a BS Computer Science student at Holy Angel University, graduating in April 2027. I’m interested in the space where visual ideas become functional, intuitive experiences.

My work begins with UI/UX design and extends into software development, backend development, and AI/ML. I enjoy connecting what an experience looks like with how it works.
